note: Rebuild the staged port from the current linux-port.patch, which now averages the head readback over the valid rectangle instead of the whole padded buffer. This must run and exit 0 before r2026-10-27-i. Quote the final stamp line - port base and patch sha - so i's numbers are tied to the binary that produced them. A build that exits 0 but stamps an older patch means the apply skipped and the measurement would read the previous binary.
